name: ulara-ds
$doc: R326 M0.4 — the ONE source of truth for the shared ds design tokens (web + mobile). Provenance: frontend/src/styles/tokens/tokens.css (R313/R322/R323/R324 canon) and the r325-era apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.ts hand-copy it replaces. Regen: npm run tokens:build (repo root). Outputs: frontend/src/styles/tokens/tokens.generated.css (web CSS vars, imported BEFORE tokens.css, same @layer tokens) + apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.generated.ts (mobile TS). Drift gate: npm run tokens:check (CI-enforced). Reference grammar: 'neutral.50' | 'triad.<family>.<bg|ink|deep>' | 'brand.<key>' | a semantic seat name (another ref, one tier up) | a literal '#hex'. External seat: brand.warmInk emits var(--warm-ink) on web — its definition stays hand-written in tokens.css base :root. NOT shared (deliberately): the web fluid-rem type ladder + font stacks (tokens.css hand section — web-only), the mobile px ladder lives here under typography.mobile; --state-focus-ring-color / glass / veils / charts stay hand-written in tokens.css (web-only seats). 2026 fg-seat unification: dangerFg + accentHoverFg are FIRST-CLASS semantic seats here (emitted to both halves — one source); tokens.css keeps only their doc comments, never a second declaration. 2026 brand takeover (feat/unified-brand-palette-2026): the owner-approved «Parchment & Royal» palette — royal blue #2540D9 (light) / #8AA0FF (dark) becomes THE primary signal via triad.royal; the sienna/ember era is retired (copper re-keys to the warm decorative #F15534 family); success/danger re-key to the approved #17724A/#C62828 (light) and #5FD39A/#FF7A70 (dark).

brand.$doc: The ULARA brand colours — the R359 re-measure of the reference (A3): paper #F2F1EC · ink #282828 · PRIMARY #2540D9 (dark #8AA0FF) — the action colour — plus the warm DECORATIVE accent #F15534 (never an action or a danger tone; the retired sienna/ember hexes #C43E16/#FF6B3D are gone from the brand seats — copper re-keys to the warm decorative family) and the warm label ink #262623. #262019 survives only as the dark surface (neutral.dark.50). Contrast (WCAG 2.2 relative luminance, recomputed): primary on paper 6.62:1 · white on primary 7.46:1 · white on hover 10.02:1 · dark primary on dark ground 6.56:1 · dark ink #262019 on dark primary 6.56:1 (the owner-verified pair — white on it FAILS at 2.46:1 and is never used) · white on dark hover 4.83:1. Consumed by the brand kit (ulara-kit.mjs cross-check: colors.accent ≡ brand.primary) and the semantic seat refs; web emits var(--warm-ink) refs only.

neutral.$doc: The warm paper ramp (R359 re-key to the measured reference seats). Light: the paper ground #F2F1EC over white surfaces, ink #282828, secondary text #646464 (neutral.500), hairline #B3B3AF (neutral.300) (15.84:1 AAA — was #262019, which survives only as the DARK ground). Dark: the charcoal #262019 itself as ground, surfaces one step up (#2E2E2E), warm hairlines, near-white ink #F0F0EB. neutral-900 dark is the paper twin (was #F6F8FA — that spelling is on the parity gate's FORBIDDEN list).

triad.$doc: The 10 families (the 2026 royal takeover + the r305 re-key, engine-verified contrasts): each a soft tinted ground (band fill), a saturated ink for fills/UI accents, a deep shade for text. ROYAL is the brand-primary family (the ONE signal — light #2540D9 6.62:1 on paper AA, dark #8AA0FF 6.56:1 on the night ground AA). MINT re-keys to the approved success #17724A/#5FD39A (ink-on-bg: light 4.87 · dark 6.80). ROSE re-keys to the approved danger #C62828/#FF7A70 (light ink-on-bg 4.56 · deep-on-bg 7.22 kept). COPPER retires from the brand seat and re-keys to the warm decorative #F15534 family (≡ peach; deep-on-bg 6.29 both). Badge-rarity pins (yellow/grey/peach deep-vs-bg ≥4.5 both themes) and icon-well pins (light -deep on -bg ≥3:1) verified: mint 7.31 · yellow 7.85 · rose 7.22 · sky 7.74 · peach 6.29 · grey 12.55 (light-900 re-key #1A1713) · sand 7.62 · lavender 9.24 · copper 6.29.

mint.$doc: The success family — re-keyed to the owner-approved green: #17724A light (5.26:1 on paper AA) · #5FD39A dark (8.65:1 AAA). Deep stays the AAA text tier on the tinted grounds (7.31 light / 9.76 dark).

rose.$doc: The danger family — re-keyed to the owner-approved red: #C62828 light (4.99:1 on paper AA · 4.56:1 on the tint) · #FF7A70 dark (6.35:1 AA). The retired #F15534 coral ink moves OUT of danger into the warm decorative seat (peach/copper) — danger no longer rhymes with the signal.

royal.$doc: THE brand-primary family (the 2026 takeover) — the sole primary signal. Light: royal blue #2540D9 (6.62:1 on paper AA · 6.18:1 on the soft #E4E9FF) with white labels at 7.46:1 AAA; hover/strong tier #1B30B0 (white 10.02:1 AAA · 8.89:1 on paper). Dark: #8AA0FF (6.56:1 on the night ground AA) with the DARK foreground #262019 (6.56:1 — the owner-verified pair; white on it FAILS at 2.46:1 and must never be used); hover #4C63F0 takes WHITE labels (4.83:1 AA); strong text tier #A9B8FF (6.85:1 on the dark soft #2A2F4A · 8.43:1 on the night ground — the r351-main derived tier dad2373 adopted). The soft grounds: #E4E9FF light (the approved primary subtle background) · #2A2F4A dark (blue-tinted night — NEVER the light value).

copper.$doc: The warm decorative family (retired from the brand seat) — re-keyed to the owner-approved warm accent #F15534, identical to peach (deep-on-bg 6.29 light). Status/chip tones that previously rode the old-brand sienna (#C43E16) keep a warm home here: PUBLISHED/GRADED/LIVE chips, brand badges, illustration hue-1, the iso-plate signal. It is NOT the primary, NOT a link, NOT a button, NOT danger — decorative + independently-semantic warm chips only (ordinary small text never rides the raw ink; chips text routes through deep).

semantic.$doc: The role seats components consume. Two-surface rule: bg = PAGE GROUND (paper), surface = CARD GROUND — hierarchy via surface step + hairlines, zero shadows (R313). 2026 «Parchment & Royal»: the accent family routes through triad.royal — light #2540D9 fills with WHITE labels (7.46:1 AAA, no AA exception needed anymore) and #2540D9 accent TEXT (6.62:1 AA — ink ≡ accent now that blue clears AA by itself); dark #8AA0FF fills with the DARK #262019 labels (6.56:1 — white on it fails, never use). primary ≡ the royal blue (primary CTAs/buttons/selected states). Status -ink ≡ the family ink in dark; success/danger ride the re-keyed mint/rose.

mobile.$doc: Mobile-only palette seats (no web var counterpart): the hover step and the sheet-overlay ground, expressed as refs so they track the ramps.

tones.$doc: The status-tone families (mobile statusTones / notification & attendance kinds), in display order.

webAliases.$doc: Web-only alias namespace (r305 — the warm secondary of the reference; resolves onto the peach seat). Emitted verbatim into both theme blocks.

spacing.$doc: The 4px-base ladder. `webRungs` carries the HISTORICAL web rung names (the r305 re-key kept the names and re-keyed the values — index ≠ px/4 above --sp-6: --sp-7 IS 32px, --sp-16 IS 240px); `px` is the px-keyed ladder the mobile app consumes. Every webRung value must exist in px with the same value (validated). The --sp-Nx legacy aliases stay hand-written in tokens.css.

radius.$doc: R313: the ladder collapses to 0 — square corners everywhere; ONLY genuinely circular primitives (avatars, status dots) consume full.

motion.$doc: R359 — the measured mechanical register (the reference re-measure): a THREE-value ladder 160/320/640ms on ONE mechanical easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) — constant departure, decelerating arrival, dead stop. No springs, no bounce, no overshoot anywhere (the spring vocabulary in tokens.css re-points here). micro 160 = hover/press color; fast 320 = small reveals, sheets, route transitions; base/slow/slower 640 = section reveals, drawn hairlines. Web: the prefers-reduced-motion kill in tokens.css zeroes the rungs by import order.

typography.$doc: The mobile px ladder (Arabic 13px readability floor; hierarchy via weight + size, no tracking). The WEB type voice is the fluid-rem ladder + font stacks hand-written in tokens.css (R313) — platform-specific by design, not shared here.
